### BFrame.tail

``` python
def tail(
    n:int=5
):
```

*Call self as a function.*

Do I need `_proc` in my Github project?

##### 🤖Reply🤖<!-- SOLVEIT_SEPARATOR_7f3a9b2c -->

- ⏳
  `web_search(type="search", queries="['site:nbdev.fast.ai _proc nbdev', 'site…", query="site:nbdev.fast.ai _proc nbdev")`
  ⏳

``` json
{
  "id": "ws_0b948a46d78e7774016ae0936eed5c87d1ad7ced1f7855cbc6",
  "name": "web_search",
  "args": {
    "type": "search",
    "queries": [
      "site:nbdev.fast.ai _proc nbdev",
      "site:github.com/fastai/nbdev \"_proc\""
    ],
    "query": "site:nbdev.fast.ai _proc nbdev"
  },
  "result": "Server tool call executed.",
  "server": true
}
```

No—assuming `_proc/` is the directory generated by **nbdev**, you
normally **should not commit it to GitHub**.

It contains intermediate, preprocessed notebooks and Quarto files used
to build or preview documentation. nbdev recreates it as needed, so add
this to `.gitignore`:

``` gitignore
_proc/
```

Keep your source notebooks, exported package, configuration, and other
hand-authored files under version control. `_proc/` is mainly useful
locally for debugging documentation processing or publishing through
Quarto.
([nbdev.fast.ai](https://nbdev.fast.ai/explanations/docs.html?utm_source=openai))[\*](https://nbdev.fast.ai/explanations/docs.html?utm_source=openai "Docs Website – nbdev")

``` json
{"model": "gpt-5.6-sol", "prompt_tokens": 48125, "completion_tokens": 289, "total_tokens": 48414, "cached_tokens": 41600, "reasoning_tokens": 155, "cost": 0.007435500000000001}
```

Can I remove the whole thing to fix?

##### 🤖Reply🤖<!-- SOLVEIT_SEPARATOR_7f3a9b2c -->

Yes. You can safely delete the entire `_proc/` directory; nbdev will
regenerate it during the next docs build.

From the project root:

``` bash
rm -rf _proc
nbdev_docs
```

If the problem persists, `_proc/` was not the underlying cause—the
source notebook or docs configuration likely needs fixing. Keep `_proc/`
excluded from Git:

``` gitignore
_proc/
```

